body.name: InputRep
body.def: \(\mathfrak R=(n,J,K,\alpha,\gamma,\zeta,w_{\max},\mathcal H,\overline\varepsilon_n,\mathfrak O)\), where \(\mathcal H\) has rational endpoints and, on every query \(m\in\mathbb N\), each component of \(\mathfrak O\) returns an outward rational interval of width at most \(2^{-m}\); a rational symmetric-matrix box covers \(\mathcal K_V\), boxes certified disjoint from its spectral inequalities are discarded, and every undecided box is retained as an outer box for the optimization over \(V\)
body.role: finite names for all data, envelopes, and optimized parameters used by calibration
